text: Yes. Albert isn't a bank, but funds in your Albert Cash account are held at an FDIC-member partner bank and are insured up to $250,000 per depositor, per insured bank, through pass-through insurance. The insurance protects your deposits if the partner bank fails, but it doesn't cover losses from other causes, such as unauthorized transactions. You can confirm the current partner bank and coverage details in the app's account disclosures or on Albert's website.
